rv.q: It is a shaming message, in a production fluidly staged by Gareth Nicholls for the Tron and Edinburgh’s Traverse. If its imaginative collision of pathos, comedy, polemic and drug-induced dream sequence creates an uneven pace and some bumpy shifts in tone, it is also a clear-eyed plea for cash as well as compassion.
' Black Hole Sign’ , written by Uma Nada-Rajah portrays a fast-paced account of one night inside an understaffed NHS ward.
Black Hole Sign is an intelligently complex play that bears often funny, incisive witness to both the remarkable work of NHS staff and the precarious condition of Britain’s most beloved institution.
